test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the **INCORRECTLY** spelt word.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is 'Equillibrium'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The correct spelling for the word is *equilibrium *which means a state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced.
 
• The **meanings **of the other **options** are as follows - 
 
 
• Equine - relating to or affecting horses or other members of the horse family.
 
• Equilateral - having all its sides of the same length.
 
• Equanimity - calmness, and composure, especially in a difficult situation.
 
 
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.
